items.title_fr: Four “Aura Seeker” Secret Rares Revealed: Blastoise, Hatterene, Hawlucha, Mega Lucario Z ex!
items.summary_fr: Creatures has officially revealed three Illustration Rares and one Special Illustration Rare from Aura Seeker . The set will release in Japan on November 27th. In English we'll get the cards in our Flowing Fists set on February 5th.

items.title_fr: “30th Celebration” Pull Rates and Most Valuable Cards Worldwide: Friendliest Pull Rates of the Modern Era!
items.summary_fr: The pull rates for 30th Celebration have been determined by our friends at TCGplayer after opening 3,000 English booster packs. As expected, like 2021's Celebrations, the set gives fans easy access to most rarities -- making it a true celebration! The set's Special Illustration Rares are 4x easier to pull than those from recent sets, at 1 in 21 booster packs (in Pitch Black it was 1 in 80).

items.title_fr: “Wonderful Waters” Mini Tins Revealed for January!
items.summary_fr: A nouveau set of TCG mini tins named "Wonderful Waters" will release on January 29th! As usual, they will cost $9.99 each. They'll include two booster packs, a sticker sheet, an art card of the tin's illustration, and a code card.

items.title_fr: “Aura Seeker” All 78 Main Set Cards Revealed!
items.summary_fr: All 78 main set cards from Aura Seeker have been officially revealed! The set stars Mega Lucario Z ex and will release in Japan on November 27th as their seventh Mega Evolution set. This is the first set to feature the Z Mega Evolutions from the Mega Dimension DLC.

items.title_fr: Talonflame ex Takes Flight — A look into Delta Reign’s Strongest Card
items.summary_fr: Hello PokeBeach readers, SmartTCG here. I'm excited to be back writing another article for you all! With the brand nouveau set Delta Reign finally upon us, I've been spending a ton of time testing the new cards, exploring different deck ideas, and figuring out how this set is going to impact the competitive Pokemon TCG metagame.

items.title_fr: “Flowing Fists” TCG Set Officially Revealed for February, Full Product Lineup Revealed!
items.summary_fr: Flowing Fists starring Mega Lucario Z ex has now been officially revealed! It will release on Saturday, February 6th as our seventh English Mega Evolution set. This marks the first time a set will release on a Saturday.

items.title_fr: Nintendo réapprovisionnements Metroid Dread Physical Copies Ahead Of Metroid Ravenous Launch
items.summary_fr: Demand for Dread. When Nintendo announced Metroid Ravenous for the Switch 2, there was a reported increase in Metroid Dread sales. This also led to a supposed boost in physical sales of the "out-of-print" Switch title, with some online listings asking "well above" the retail prix.

items.title_fr: Pokemon China Unveils 30 Pure Gold Pikachu Cards for 30th Anniversary Celebration!
items.summary_fr: As part of Pokemon's 30th anniversary celebrations, Pokemon China has created pure gold versions of all 30 Pikachu cards from 30th Celebration . The cards will be displayed at a " Pokemon Card Art Illustration Exhibition " at Shanghai's Lafayette Culture and Arts Center from November 28th through December 27th. ...

items.title_fr: Pokémon Champions Is Adding Four More Mega Evolutions In A New Update Next Week
items.summary_fr: 24 newly added Pokémon will also be available for battle. Following the news of a Pokémon Champions balance patch update, The Pokémon Company has now revealed some new competitors are preparing to arrive in the free-to-play battle title. Read the full article on nintendolife.com

items.title_fr: "Here We Go Again" - After Delaying For Silksong, Indie Dev Braces For A Sea Of Sorrow Clash
items.summary_fr: "Does the universe have it in for us?". There were a good few indies set for launch in September last year that ended up being delayed to escape the blast radius of Hollow Knight: Silksong . Aeternum Game Studios' metroidvania, Aeterna Lucis , was one such title, pushing its date de sortie to 3rd December 2026 to ensure it was way out of the way of whatever Team Cherry was cooking up.

items.title_fr: The Witcher 3 Remastered Ver. 5.02 Update Is Now Live, Here Are The Full Patch Notes
items.summary_fr: Toss a patch to your Witcher. CD Projekt Red is still sending out the patches for The Witcher III: Wild Hunt - Remastered , and the latest has gone live today. The ver.

items.title_fr: One Of 2025's Best Roguelikes Will Soon Be Free For Switch Online Members
items.summary_fr: Rogue 'em up until 3rd December. Nintendo is back with another Free Game Trial for all of its NSO members in Europe, and it's a real good'un this time. Last year's wonderful roguelike, Absolum , is the next game in the spotlight, available for free to all those with a Nintendo Switch Online subscription in Europe from tomorrow ( 27th November ) until 3rd December .

items.title_fr: Nintendo Promises To Fix The Long Load Times On Pikmin 4 - Switch 2 Edition
items.summary_fr: "We apologise for the inconvenience". Nintendo has issued a statement acknowledging load time issues on Pikmin 4 - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy on Switch 2. The company has promised to released a patch addressing the concerns, citing the long load times that primarily occur when travelling to surface areas.

items.title_fr: EA Sports FC 27 Is Using AI To Add The Voice Of Late Commentator John Motson
items.summary_fr: Motson's widow and son gave permission. EA Sports FC 27 will today add the voice of the iconic commentator John Motson, who sadly passed away in 2023. This marks the first instance a dead commentator will be added to the game, and EA has used a combination of old recordings and AI to make it happen.

items.title_fr: Ubisoft Employees Reportedly Need To Justify Not Using AI When Pitching Projects
items.summary_fr: You WILL use it, minions! A new report from Vertical Slice reveals that Ubisoft is now requesting that its internal teams explain how they intend to utilise generative AI to accelerate and streamline production of new projects. Any staff not intending to use the technology must explain why it's not a suitable fit.

items.title_fr: Gold & Silver TCG Products to Release Alongside Pokemon ex★ Series!
items.summary_fr: As reported earlier this week , the new Pokemon ex★ series will launch in Japan on May 21st with three sets: Magma Heartbeat, Lightning Impact, and Aurora Ripples, featuring Entei, Raikou, and Suicune, respectively. This marks the first time three TCG sets will release on the same day. ...
